Team leader

Meet the advisor

Xu Chao

PROFESSOR · DOCTORAL SUPERVISOR

  • Ph.D., Technical University of Munich
  • National Young Talent Program Awardee
  • Distinguished Professor, Hundred Talents Program, Guangdong University of Technology

His research focuses on urban ecological and environmental systems engineering, the eco-environmental effects of urbanization, and urban green infrastructure. He has led multiple national and provincial research projects, including the National Science Fund for Excellent Young Scholars (Overseas), the General Program of the National Natural Science Foundation of China, and the General Program of the Natural Science Foundation of Guangdong Province.

01RESEARCH AREAS

Urban ecological and environmental systems engineering
Eco-environmental effects of urbanization
Urban green infrastructure

02ACADEMIC SERVICE

Graduate co-supervisor at Humboldt University of Berlin; Guest Editor of the SCI journal Frontiers in Sustainable Cities; reviewer for several leading journals in related fields.
